name: Meghalaya Motorcaravan Scheme
benefit:
**Down Payment/Margin Money Support:**
Total down payment will be 50% of the price of the vehicle. Of this:

1. 5% of the caravan price is to be paid by the entrepreneur to the bank.
1. 45% of the caravan price will be paid by the Government of Meghalaya to the entrepreneur through the bank.

**EMI Support:**

1. To reduce the operational cost burden in the first year, the Government of Meghalaya
_eligibility_text: **Individuals** 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant must hold a valid driving license. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The applicant shall not be a credit defaulter from any bank. **For Registered Entities:** 1. The entity must be a recognized and registered tourism operator or tourism society with the Tourism Department, Government of Meghalaya. 1. The entity must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The entity shall not be a defaulter at any financial institution. 1. The entity must provide an Incorporation Certificate or registration certificate, whichever is applicable. 1. The entity shall not be a credit defaulter from any bank. **For Unregistered Entities:** 1. The entity can be any unregistered organization such as village organizations, self-help groups, or traditional communities based in Meghalaya. 1. The entity must be actively involved in the tourism sector. 1. The entity must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The entity shall not be a credit defaulter at any financial institution.
